parakeet: Tell me, what type of God needs blood to feel better about his own creation? You ever stop and think about how wild that is? That the central symbol of the Christian faith is a tortured man nailed to wood. Not compassion, not wisdom, not even peace, a crucified body, dripping, broken, and bleeding. And they told you that was love.
